send_user_invitation_email: send an email to a user after inviting them to the team with an invitation link
send_key_created_email: send an email to a user after creating a virtual API key with key details and budget info
send_key_rotated_email: send an email to a user after rotating their virtual API key with updated key details
send_soft_budget_alert_email: send an email alert when a user or team soft budget threshold is crossed
send_max_budget_alert_email: send an email alert when a max budget spending threshold percentage is reached
